fixed_reference.execution: deterministic_tanh_mean; original float32 batch-one operation order

limitations: Nonzero within-source spread describes present-output alignment only; it does not establish usefulness after learning or causally important controls.
All 14 MPPI demonstrations are recorded successful full-length executions; variation among their scores does not label any as bad task behavior.
Reference self-trajectory zeros are a deterministic self-consistency control, not evidence of useful discrimination between alternative successful MPPI behaviors.
Random actions fall after 8 to 26 controls; their unpadded full-execution scores concern short prefixes and do not identify a matched-horizon task-success boundary.
The four original discovery curated inputs explicitly lack terminal-state, warmstart and integration arrays despite the original provenance descriptor; no exact replay claim is added.

Preserved 100-control bins allow within-trajectory temporal inspection but do not provide raw per-control residuals in this summary. Raw prediction/action/observation SHA descriptors are carried for provenance without reading or recomputing arrays.
No ranking rule, metric tuning, acceptance threshold or next intervention is selected.

metric.D: 6*N*E; algebraic re-expression of saved E, not a new raw-array sum or a different score
metric.length_scope: D is length-dependent; equal-N MPPI/reference traces have D=6000E, while early-falling random traces have N=8,26,22,14. Do not compare their D magnitudes as if horizons matched.
metric.mask_scope: Executed healthy-prefix rows, including the final fall-causing action for random episodes. These full-execution diagnostic rows do not instantiate a CoupledSelector supported-mask query.
metric.rounding: D is derived from stored binary64 MSE, so raw-sum operation-order roundoff is not reconstructed.
metric.state_order: Each trajectory own recorded successive pre-action observations; original stage roster and row order preserved. Every executed row scored; no padding or new support mask.
metric.units: Six common bounded action components, each in [-1,1], reference scale=1 and bias=0. No action renormalization or relabeling.

scope: Saved-only descriptive extraction of the already frozen recorded-label action-MSE for one fixed reference actor on each individual executed trajectory. No re-query, relabeling, metric selection, fitted model, physics or learning.
